Name: Lord of the Axes
Author: HappyFamilyFarm
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Tired of hitting the same tree three times with an iridium axe, burning stamina and chasing wood chips across the farm? Lord of the Axes is a legendary tool from a mysterious stranger that fells a whole tree in one hit, costs no stamina, swings in a fraction of the usual time, and pulls every drop straight to you. Built for Stardew Valley 1.6 + SMAPI 4.x.

A mysterious stranger mails you the axe once your foraging level reaches 1. Already past level 1? The letter is delivered when you load the save, so old farms get it on the next login. The axe behaves like a normal axe because it is one: a vanilla axe under the hood, with vanilla animations, sounds and drops. No new menus, no pop-ups, no save data rewritten. All effects are applied per player and per machine, so multiplayer should be fine, though it has not been tested in a co-op session yet.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI (4.0 or later).
2. Install Content Patcher (2.0 or later).
3. Download this mod and unzip it.
4. Copy both folders — LordOfTheAxes and [CP] Lord of the Axes — into your game's Mods folder (usually C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods).
5. Launch the game via SMAPI. Done!

To uninstall, delete both folders and drop the axe from your inventory first, or it will turn into an error item.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]One-hit felling:[/b] Swing once and the whole tree comes down — trunk and stump cleared in the same hit, with the vanilla amount of wood, sap and seeds.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Stumps and logs included:[/b] Old stumps left by other axes, the giant stumps in the forest and the large logs that normally need a steel axe all come apart in one swing, with their normal loot.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Fast swings:[/b] Exactly 300 ms per swing in all four directions, measured over the full five-frame animation. Only this axe is affected.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]No stamina cost:[/b] Swing all day, your energy never moves.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Loot vacuum:[/b] Each swing boosts your magnetism by 10,000 for about two seconds — long enough for the falling tree's drops to fly straight to you instead of scattering.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Double foraging XP:[/b] Everything chopped with this axe gives double foraging XP, including trees, stumps, logs and moss. Other tools stay vanilla.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Works with old saves:[/b] Nothing is written into your save file. Load an old farm, check the mailbox, done.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Never lost:[/b] Passing out or getting knocked out won't take the axe away from you.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6 (PC)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher 2.0.0 or newer[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]No other mods needed. Both dependencies are required, or the game will report missing content.[/color]
